Create a Content-Addressed Response Cache for LLM Coding

Source: R/cache.R
coding_cache.Rd

Creates a memory-backed, disk-backed, or disabled cache keyed by SHA-256 hashes of (schema, unit_id, prompt, model, temperature, replicate, backend). Disk caches enforce path-safe canonical keys (blocking directory traversal), atomic temporary-file + rename writes, and SHA-256 payload integrity checksums with automatic eviction of corrupted entries.

Usage

coding_cache(type = c("memory", "disk", "none"), dir = NULL)

Arguments

type

Storage mode: "memory" (default, session-scoped), "disk" (persistent checksummed .rds files in dir), or "none" (caching disabled).

dir

Directory path for "disk" caching. Must be explicitly supplied when type = "disk" (created automatically if it does not exist).

Value

An object of class "llm_coding_cache".

Examples

mem_cache <- coding_cache("memory")
cache_stats(mem_cache)
#> $type
#> [1] "memory"
#> 
#> $dir
#> NULL
#> 
#> $hits
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $misses
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $writes
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $evictions
#> [1] 0
#> 
#> $entries
#> [1] 0
#>
